experimental_design: structural characterization of Hsp70 and Hsp90 complexes via XL-MS

The Hsp70:p53-TMGST complex was treated with 3,3′-dithiobis(sulfosuccinimidyl propionate) (DTSSP)... The crosslinked complex was trypsin-digested and the resulting peptides analysed by liquid chromatography coupled to tandem mass spectrometry (LC-MS/MS).
number_of_fractions: Peptides were eluted with six C2H7NO2 concentrations
